summary: Restoring an earlier name leaves the intervening name in the record as a variant.
realLife: The committee restored Spring Lake and directed that Lake Killian remain a variant. The Wisconsin register lists Spring Lake under feature 1574672, and the national names file lists Lake Killian under that same number.
inGame: needs: the restoration vote, the former and restored names, the feature number and the published list of variants.

turns.what: The clerk records the restored name and the instruction to retain the intervening name.
turns.pulledBy: The motion restoring the name passes with a variant instruction.
turns.writesBack: The minutes tie both names to the feature. Publication still needs confirmation.

turns.what: A resident looks up the displaced name in the variants list.
turns.pulledBy: The published list gives that variant the same feature number as the restored name.
turns.writesBack: The resident can match the old name to the current entry.
